title: EmoRouter: Adaptive Modality Cascading for Multimodal Emotion Recognition
abstract: arXiv:2611.28960v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal Emotion Recognition (MER) involves detecting the underlying emotion behind each utterance within a conversation, which is essential for emotionally aware human-computer interaction. While omni-modal large language models (Omni-LLMs) demonstrate strong capability for MER by jointly processing modalities including text, audio, and vision, different modality combinations yield different prediction outcomes across utterances: acoustic and visual inputs can help recover annotated labels missed by text-only inference, but can also turn correct predictions into errors. Processing all modalities for every utterance is also computationally expensive. To this end, we introduce EmoRouter, a training-free, model-agnostic framework for adaptive modality cascading that selects an exit tier for each utterance along a predefined modality order. The routing is guided by prediction-uncertainty estimates derived from Conformal Prediction. EmoRou

translated_title: EmoRouter：面向多模态情感识别的自适应模态级联方法
translated_abstract: 多模态情感识别（MER）旨在检测对话中每句话背后所蕴含的情感，这对于具备情感感知能力的人机交互至关重要。尽管全模态大语言模型通过联合处理文本、音频和视觉等多种模态，在多模态情感识别任务上展现出强大的能力，但不同的模态组合在不同的语句上会产生不同的预测结果：声学和视觉输入可以帮助找回仅用文本推理时遗漏的标注标签，但也可能将原本正确的预测变为错误。此外，对每一句话都处理所有模态在计算上也十分昂贵。为此，我们提出了EmoRouter，一个无需训练、与模型无关的自适应模态级联框架，它沿着预定义的模态顺序为每句话选择一个退出层级。该路由过程由基于共形预测得出的预测不确定性估计所引导。
tldr: 提出了一种无需训练、与模型无关的EmoRouter框架，利用基于共形预测的不确定性估计，自适应地为每条话语选择模态级联的退出层级，在提升多模态情感识别准确率的同时降低计算开销。
en_tdlr: EmoRouter is a training-free, model-agnostic framework that adaptively selects modality cascade exit tiers for each utterance using conformal-prediction-based uncertainty estimates, improving multimodal emotion recognition accuracy while reducing computational cost.
